search_log: Searched "Total Control" "David Baldacci" with excerpt, first chapter, point of view, third person, omniscient, and narrator terms; opened the BookRags point-of-view analysis and the Virginian-Pilot review.

Searched publisher, author, library, Google Books, Open Library, and OverDrive sources. Google Books and OverDrive exposed official preview controls or metadata, but no readable prose through the research interface; Hachette and Pan Macmillan pages supplied synopsis only.

Searched for epistolary, diary, letters, frame narrative, multiple narrators, and alternating point of view; found no credible indication of sustained first- or second-person sections or an alternating-person structure.
Opened an unofficial Chapter One transcription only as low-tier corroboration and did not treat search snippets or synopsis grammar as decisive evidence.
person_note: Sustained quote passages q00007, q00008, and q00012 externally narrate Jason, Sidney, and other characters and access character perceptions without any participating I/we narrator. First-person forms in the sample occur in dialogue and are local character speech. The whole-book point-of-view description explicitly identifies third-person narration, while independent opening and interior passages corroborate it; targeted searches found no frame, epistolary construction, or alternating-person sections. The main uncertainty is that accessible web prose coverage was limited and the explicit whole-book source was Tier C, so confidence is medium.
